issues.failure_explanation: The localisation step gives the factor |Omega_eps|^{-1/p}. In the final chain the exponent silently becomes -d/p. For |Omega|>1, |Omega|^{-d/p} is strictly smaller than |Omega|^{-1/p}, so the stated estimate is not established. The proof also writes the W^{n,r} norm with L^q norms, and passes to lim |Omega_eps| without justification.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate with the factor |Omega|^{-1/p}, using lim|Omega_eps|=|closure of Omega| under a null-boundary assumption. Write the L^r norms consistently.
issues.overall_effect: The stated domain dependence of the modulation-to-Sobolev embedding, and of its two corollaries, is unproved.
issues.title: Claimed |Omega|^{-d/p} factor not supported by the proof, which yields |Omega_eps|^{-1/p}
issues.why_classification: The method survives, but the advertised dependence on |Omega| must be changed in the proposition and its dependents.

issues.failure_explanation: The bound ||(|F|*|G|)||_{L^q_{v_s}} <= ||F||_{L^q_{v_s}}||G||_{L^1} holds only for s=0. For s≠0 it requires ||G||_{L^1_{v_{|s|}}}, so the constant 1 is unjustified. The lemma is also stated for 0<q<=infinity, but Young's inequality L^q*L^1 into L^q fails for q<1.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict to q>=1 and include the factor ||ĝ||_{L^1_{v_{|s|}}}, which depends on the radius R of the window support. For q<1, a Plancherel–Polya type argument would be needed.
issues.overall_effect: The constant-free bound |Omega+Omega|^{1/p} is unproved for s≠0 and for q<1. The explicit constants in the Fourier-Lebesgue and Barron results inherit this.
issues.title: Weighted Young step uses an unweighted window norm and fails for q<1
issues.why_classification: A contained correction keeps a comparable lemma, but the explicit constant and the q<1 range need new work.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof shows Omega+Omega=2Omega for convex Omega. Its measure is 2^d|Omega|, so the argument gives 2^{d/p}|Omega|^{1/p}, not 2^{1/p}|Omega|^{1/p}. The claim is unproved for d>=2.

failure_location.quote: can be improved by replacing \(|\Omega + \Omega|^{1/p}\) with \(2^{1/p} |\Omega|^{1/p}\)

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace 2^{1/p} by 2^{d/p} here, and the factor 2 by the corresponding 2^d-type factor downstream.
issues.overall_effect: The convex-domain bounds with factor 2|Omega| in the Fourier-Lebesgue and Barron results lack support.
issues.title: Convex case: |Omega+Omega| equals 2^d|Omega|, not 2|Omega|
issues.why_classification: The correction is short but loses content: the constant becomes exponential in d, against the advertised explicit, dimension-friendly constants.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: M^2_{v_s}(\rr d) = L^2_s(\rr d)\cap \cF L^2_s(\rr d)= Q^s(\rr d)

issues.failure_explanation: Q^{s} carries the joint weight <(x,xi)>^{s}, not v_{s1}⊗v_{s2}, so Q^{s2} does not embed in M^2_{v_{s1}⊗v_{s2}}. A direct Cauchy–Schwarz estimate gives Q^{s} into M^1_{1⊗v_{n+1}} only for s>n+1+d. Similarly, L^2_{s1}∩FL^2_{s2} carries a sum-type weight, not the product weight. The cited embedding theorem is also only a sufficient condition, not an 'if and only if'.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Re-derive the index ranges for joint and sum weights, e.g. require s_2>n+1+d for the Q^{s_2} bound and the corresponding conditions for the L^2∩FL^2 branch.
issues.overall_effect: Both bounds in eq:Hilbert_approximation_bound_L are unsupported under the stated index conditions.
issues.title: Shubin/L^2 corollary uses joint-weight spaces as if they had tensor weights; indices insufficient
issues.why_classification: A comparable corollary survives after reoptimising the indices, but the stated ranges are lost.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: for any $f\in M^{p,q}_{1\otimes v_{s_2}}(\rr d)$, with $0<p<\infty$

issues.failure_explanation: The theorem bounds the error by ||f||_{M^{p,q}_{v_{s1}⊗v_{s2}}} of f on all of R^d. The lemma only controls chi_Omega f, which is discontinuous and is not the function approximated. ||f||_{M^{p,q}} is not bounded by ||f||_{FL^q} for non-compactly supported f; band-limited f with slow decay is a counterexample for p<=1. For p>1 the theorem needs s_1>d/p', yet the weight 1⊗v_{s2} is used. The factor |Omega+Omega| (not ^{1/p}) and the loss of |Omega|^{1/r} are also unexplained.

failure_location.quote: The proof is a combination of \cref{thm:approximation_sobolev_space_local} and \cref{cor:FourierLebesgue_embedding_in_modulation_space}

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Approximate psi f, with psi in C_c^infty equal to 1 on Omega. Bound ||psi f||_{M^{p,q}_m} by a support factor times ||psi f||_{FL^q_{v_{s2}}}, and bound that by ||psi^||_{L^1_{v_{s2}}}||f||_{FL^q_{v_{s2}}} for q>=1. Restate the constants accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The Fourier-Lebesgue and Barron Sobolev approximation bounds, with their explicit domain factors, are unproved.
issues.title: Fourier–Lebesgue approximation misapplies the lemma (f vs chi_Omega f) and drops the x-weight
issues.why_classification: A contained new cutoff argument gives a comparable N^{-1/2} result, but the stated constants and the q<1 range must change.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: At this step, in order to obtain a uniform upper bound, it is necessary to assume that the set $\Omega\subset \rrd$ is bounded.

issues.failure_explanation: eq:f_representation comes from the STFT inversion formula and integrates over all y in R^d. mu_f therefore charges atoms with y outside Omega, which do not belong to D̃_Omega, so f is not shown to lie in K(D̃_Omega). Concretely, take f a Gaussian centred at z with p,q<=1 and s_1=0: ||f||_{M^{p,q}_m} is independent of z. Yet any element of Sigma_{N,M_f}(D̃_Omega) has size at most about M_f<z>^s e^{-c|z|^2} near z. Hence the claimed uniform N^{-1/2} bound fails for large |z|.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must either allow y in all of R^d while keeping the dictionary bounded in W^{n,r}(R^d), or restrict to f localised near Omega with a weight compensating the restriction.
issues.overall_effect: The global approximation theorem on R^d and its Feichtinger and Bessel-potential corollaries are unproved.
issues.title: Global theorem: dictionary restricts y to Omega but the representation integrates over all y
issues.why_classification: The central global guarantee fails as argued, and no comparable version is supported without new proof architecture.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof needs ||f||_{M^1_{1⊗v_{n+s}}} with s>1, because ∫v_{-s}(b)db diverges for s=1. For q<=1, eq:indices allows s_2=n+1, which would need s=1. Cor:added-2 itself requires s_2>n+1, and Cor:added-3 again uses the endpoint.

failure_location.quote: The arguments above work for any index $s>1$, this allows to extend the range of $s_2$ as in \eqref{eq:indices}, providing to choose $s>1$ accordingly.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Require s_2>n+1 when q<=1, in the theorem and in cor:added-3.
issues.overall_effect: The endpoint case q<=1, s_2=n+1 is unproved in the global theorem and in its Bessel-potential corollary.
issues.title: Global theorem endpoint s_2=n+1 (q<=1) not covered since s>1 is required
issues.why_classification: Only a boundary case is excluded; the method, rate and scope otherwise remain.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: where $\sigma$ is a standard activation function e.g., $ReLU$

issues.failure_explanation: The theorems require sigma in W^{k,infty} with k>=n, which excludes ReLU because it is unbounded. In the modulation atom the window phi(a-t) shares its bias with sigma(a). Thus sigma_ramp(a)phi(a-t) = (a-b1)_+phi(a-t) - (a-b2)_+phi(a-t) is not a combination of network atoms, whose windows would be phi(a-b_i-t). Moreover the ramp is only W^{1,infty}, so it covers at most n<=1. The claims that the experiments realise the theoretical dictionary and confirm the estimates are therefore unsupported.

failure_location.quote: can be exactly represented by linear combinations of $2$ or $3$ ReLU units, respectively

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use a bounded W^{k,infty} activation (k>=n) in the experiments, or decouple the window bias. Otherwise restate the experiments as heuristic.
issues.overall_effect: The experimental validation and the introduction's ReLU example are disconnected from the proven results.
issues.title: ReLU architecture not covered by the theory; ramp justification fails for coupled windows
issues.why_classification: The theory is unaffected, but the advertised theory–experiment link must be withdrawn or redone.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: If it vanished at any real point $(x_0,\omega_0)$, then by the identity theorem for analytic functions it would vanish on a non-empty open set

issues.failure_explanation: |V| >= T2 - |T1| does not give |V| > T2. In fact T1(0,0)=0, so |V(0,0)| = 1/(2pi) = T2(0,0), contradicting the strict inequality eq:lowerbound. The identity theorem does not let a single zero of an analytic function force vanishing on an open set. Global non-vanishing is therefore unproved.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must drop eq:lowerbound and either prove global non-vanishing by a genuine argument or weaken the claim to non-vanishing near (0,0).
issues.overall_effect: The global non-vanishing claim and the lower bound are unsupported or false. Condition (A) for ReLU still follows from V(0,0)≠0 and continuity.
issues.title: Non-vanishing and strict lower bound for the ReLU STFT: false bound, invalid proof
issues.why_classification: The strict bound is false, and no comparable global non-vanishing statement is established.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: The estimates above imply that the STFT is in $L^{1,\infty}_{v_s\otimes 1}(\rr{2})$

issues.failure_explanation: The claim |erfc(z)| <= C e^{-|z|^2}/(1+|z|) for all complex z is false: erfc(z) tends to 2 as z tends to -infinity, and |e^{-z^2}| = e^{-Re z^2}. Indeed V(x,0) = ∫_0^∞ t e^{-π(t-x)^2} dt ~ x as x→+∞, while the stated bound tends to 0. Hence the decay estimate is false, and ReLU is not in M^{1,infty}_{v_s⊗1}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must replace the bound with a correct growth estimate such as |V(x,ω)| <= C(1+|x|), and withdraw Remark rem:33.
issues.overall_effect: The decay corollary and the claimed time-frequency membership of ReLU are false.
issues.title: False erfc estimate; ReLU STFT grows, so the decay bound and the M^{1,infty} membership fail
issues.why_classification: The stated decay is false in an essential way, and no comparable decay statement survives.
